extracted.intended_audience: Investigators and research administrative staff preparing an NIH R01 renewal (PA-16-160) grant application
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and assembling Facilities & Other Resources, Major Equipment, Senior/Key Person profiles, and NIH biosketches as part of an R01 renewal submission. Includes documenting institutional resources, laboratory instrumentation, administrative support, and required biosketch content/format.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinical site description and institutional affiliations
rubrics_metrics.description: The University of Colorado Hospital (UCH) is described as a private, not-for-profit entity with very strong ties and affiliations to UC-AMC; recognized as a leading academic medical center and the major location for clinical care and research for the School of Medicine and Skaggs School of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide institutional context and affiliations, demonstrate the site's recognition/standing and role as a major location for clinical care and research. Include catchment area served (states/regions) to show reach and relevance to proposed work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinical site catchment, patient population, and demographics
rubrics_metrics.description: The IDGP provides care for approximately 1,750 patients (17% women) of all racial backgrounds (White 70%, African American/Black African 21%, Asian 2%, Native American/Pacific Islander 2%, Other 5%; Hispanic 15%) and serves a patient population from the Denver Metro Area and remote locations within Colorado and Wyoming.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document clinic size, approximate patient numbers, gender/racial/ethnic breakdowns, and geographic reach to justify access to target populations for the study. Use concrete numbers and percentages where available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinic staffing and clinical support services
rubrics_metrics.description: The IDGP is a Ryan White-funded multispecialty clinic staffed by 23 medical providers in specialties including infectious diseases/primary care, endocrinology, gynecology, hematology/oncology and psychiatry, and provides support through experienced nursing staff and social work, with an on-site pharmacy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe clinical team composition, specialty coverage, support staff, and clinical services (e.g., on-site pharmacy) to demonstrate capability to carry out clinical procedures, recruitment, and participant support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinical laboratory capabilities
rubrics_metrics.description: UCH has a large, centralized clinical laboratory, which includes hematology, chemistry, molecular virology and immunology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List available laboratory services and core capabilities that support the proposed research (e.g., hematology, chemistry, molecular virology, immunology). Show that needed lab services are available locally or via institutional cores.

rubrics_metrics.name: Computers and networked IT resources
rubrics_metrics.description: A completely networked computer system with hardware connections to the greater University of Colorado Denver system is available to all personnel for electronic mail, scientific writing, molecular analysis and information (including online journal subscription) access. UC-AMC servers are backed up every night.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document availability of networked computing resources for personnel, access to online literature, analysis tools, and regular server backups to support data security and research activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: PI office space and on-site equipment
rubrics_metrics.description: Dr. Castillo-Mancilla maintains office space (125 sq. ft.) equipped with telephones, ethernet ports, wireless internet, FAX, scanner and photocopy machines. Administrative assistants through the ID Division support the PI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify PI/co-investigator office location/size and available on-site equipment (phones, ethernet, wireless, fax/scanner/photocopy). Indicate administrative support staff availability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative resources and institutional support services
rubrics_metrics.description: The Division of Infectious Diseases provides direct administrative support for Human Resource issues, close monitoring and reporting on grant budgets, monitoring regulatory compliance and NIH-grant related regulations/deadlines, and assistance with grant submissions. Other services include telephone service, faxing, photocopying, information technology support, proactive research development (identification of new funding sources and local collaborations), and assistance with clinical protocol development and regulatory submissions (IRB, CTRC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List administrative and regulatory support available from the department/division (HR, budget monitoring, compliance, grant submission assistance, IRB/CTRC support). Emphasize institutional capacity to manage grants and regulatory processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Major equipment—state-of-the-art mass spectrometry instruments (UCSF HAL)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Hair Analytical Laboratory (HAL) at UCSF has one state-of-the-art GC-MS/MS and two LC-MS instruments necessary to accomplish quantitative mass spectrometry analysis of small molecular targets including antiretrovirals and anti-TB drugs. Instruments listed include Agilent LC 1260- AB Sciex 5500 Triple Quadrupole, Agilent LC 1260-QTOF 6550, and a Bruker Scion TQ GC-MS/MS.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly list major instruments available and their roles (e.g., dedicated to quantitative targeted analysis or non-targeted analysis). Demonstrate that instrument types and numbers are sufficient for study aims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instrument performance, sensitivity, and software capabilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Primary instrument (Agilent LC1260- AB Sciex 5500 Triple Quadrupole MS) achieves fg/mL-ng/mL (ppq-ppb) sensitivity with typical linear dynamic ranges of five orders of magnitude; Agilent LC 1260-QTOF 6550 routinely achieves mass resolutions between 25,000-40,000. Software (MassHunter Qualitative/Quantitative, Personal Compound Database and Library, Mass Profiler, Mass Structure Correlator) are available for non-targeted analysis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide performance metrics (sensitivity, dynamic range, mass resolution) and software/tooling that justify assay feasibility and analytic approaches. If instruments will be used for specific aims, state that and note any ongoing method development/validation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support equipment, sample preparation, and storage infrastructure
rubrics_metrics.description: Laboratory accessories and additional instruments include nitrogen gas generators (Peak Scientific, Parker-Hannepin), Waters solid phase extraction manifold, Biotage positive pressure extraction manifold, Omni Bead Ruptor tissue homogenizer, Biotage rotavap evaporator, tabletop centrifuge, two -80 freezers, a -20 freezer, multiple 3ft3 freezers and refrigerators, and a shared tissue culture room with laminar flow hoods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List supporting equipment, sample preparation platforms, and sample storage capabilities (freezers, refrigerators) necessary to complete the proposed assays and sample handling. Demonstrate redundancy and capacity for specimen storage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allocation of equipment usage and maintenance costs
rubrics_metrics.description: The current R01 renewal proposal has apportioned leasing and equipment maintenance contract costs on the primary machine proportionate to the work proposed here for the 3 Aims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document that equipment usage and associated costs (leasing, maintenance) are budgeted and apportioned to the project proportionally. Indicate institutional commitment to sustain instrument availability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Major equipment reporting for collaborating sites
rubrics_metrics.description: For other listed sites (University of Washington; University of Colorado) the form states: 'Not applicable for this application.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When a collaborating site has no major equipment to report for the application, explicitly indicate 'Not applicable' rather than leaving fields blank.

rubrics_metrics.name: Senior/Key Person Profile (Expanded) required fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Profile fields include Prefix, First Name, Middle Name, Last Name, Suffix, Position/Title, Organization Name, Department, Division, Street, City, State/Province, Country, Zip/Postal Code, Phone Number, E-Mail, Credential (e.g., agency login), Project Role (e.g., PD/PI), Degree Type, Degree Year, Attach Biographical Sketch, Attach Current & Pending Support, and Tracking Number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete all required profile fields for PD/PI and senior/key personnel. Attach the requested biosketch and current & pending support files with clear filenames. Provide accurate contact and credential information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch formatting and content—page limit and sections
rubrics_metrics.description: BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES. Sections include: A. Personal Statement (summary of qualifications, role, relevant experience and contributions to proposed work), B. Positions and Honors, C. Contribution to Science (numbered contributions with key publications), and D. Research Support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhere strictly to the 5-page limit. In Personal Statement, concisely connect past work to the proposed project, list mentorship roles and relevant collaborations. In Contributions to Science, provide numbered thematic descriptions and representative citations. Include current and pending support in section D or attached file as instructed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attach required support documents (biosketch and current & pending support)
rubrics_metrics.description: Fields indicate 'Attach Biographical Sketch*: File Name: [filename]' and 'Attach Current & Pending Support: File Name: [filename]'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure that all required attachments (biosketch, current & pending support) are included with the application and have clear, descriptive filenames. Confirm attachments correspond to the profile entries and roles.
